analysis:
Both changed files are documentation only: changelog.d/glm-pair-128gb-load.md (new, lines 1-6) and docs/architecture/hardware-support.md (date bump at line 3, new section at head lines 316-352). No executable code, keys, attestation, wire protocol or cache storage changed in the supplied evidence, so the threat-model assets, boundaries and mitigations are unaffected by the patch itself.

The prose describes behavior changes that live in unsupplied source: (1) GLM pipeline ranks no longer reserve the largest request at LOAD and instead admit per request on arrival (`ClusterModelLayout.requestsOnArrival`, `GLM5NextResidentResourceEnvelope`), leaving load-time safety to arrival-time live memory checks. This touches availability (A-018, T-010, T-029, TB-007) but is not verifiable here. (2) A new `darkbloom cluster gpu-limit` command raises the GPU wired-memory limit via a sysctl and a persistent job, with an administrator prompt, and installs or replaces that job when it is missing or different. This implies privileged persistence on the Mac owner's account. TB-013/A-019 and TB-003 cover the installer and add-on, but this new privileged path is not modeled. Reviewers of the code PR should check that the job path, plist ownership and permissions are not user-writable (compare T-045), that the sysctl values are bounded to memory less 16 GiB, that `--undo` restores state, and that the M5 128/256 GB gating is enforced in code and not only in docs. (3) The new retryable capacity error reports the longest context that fits now, which exposes coarse free-memory information to the coordinator. It is a minor, trusted-coordinator side channel and is self-reported (not trusted as a security signal).

The doc cites 3.4 GB of headroom beside a full request on a 128 GB Mac at default limits, which is thin and could cause OOM or availability issues, but this is a documentation figure, not a demonstrated regression. No findings are raised for these docs. The code that implements the claims was not supplied, so a deeper review of the actual implementation PR is warranted.
